title: Gemini voice safety: off by default, consent card, microphone sign (manual until automated)

clauses.text: The Gemini voice assistant is off by default and labelled EXPERIMENTAL in every string it shows.

steps.do: Open Settings and open Gemini voice (experimental).
steps.expect: The switch is off. The page and its labels say EXPERIMENTAL.

clauses.text: Its own consent names the open microphone and the tool results.

steps.do: On that page press C (Consent card) and read the card.
steps.expect: The card is titled Send my microphone to Google? (EXPERIMENTAL). It names the open microphone and that tool results are sent.

clauses.text: A yes to speech-to-text is not a yes to the open microphone.

steps.do: Give the ordinary speech-to-text yes (the voice setting), then press C to look at the Gemini consent.
steps.expect: The Gemini consent still says Not given: nothing is sent.

clauses.text: Taking the yes back with C closes the microphone at once and sends nothing more.

steps.do: After giving the Gemini yes on the card, press C and take it back.
steps.expect: The status says Not given: nothing is sent. If a session was open, the red band goes out too.

clauses.text: While the microphone is open, the shell's one red band shows it.

steps.do: With a Gemini key set up on this machine and the yes given, start a live session and speak. (If no key is set up, mark this clause cannot-test.)
steps.expect: The red band shows while the microphone is open and goes out when the session ends.
